## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0, n +1.2 → +3.25×10¹², B 0.75 → 10 T

> **05:26** · landau-fan-vti: D=0 electron fan, n +1.2..+3.25e12 (81 cols), B 0.75->10 T uniform-1/B (126 rows, d(1/B)=0.00987), sr1 100 uV / 10 kOhm FS, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6 tau), ends at 10 T · **ETA ~12:56** (≈7h30m)

**Side call (spots, runs 6/7).** Electron (run 6, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T) is the fan side: dominant tone 7.1 T (SNR 40, alive to the 0.30 T record edge) sits on the model ABAB light tone (7.3 T), with high-F content at 22.1 and 29.5 T whose identity is the open question — 22.1 ≈ 3×7.1 *and* ≈ the ABAB heavy tone (model 25.8 T, ratio drifts through 3× exactly here), 29.5 ≈ 4×7.1 *and* ≈ heavy at scale 1.15. Luttinger sums 7.1+22.1 = 0.88·F_L and 7.1+29.5 = 1.11·F_L both sit inside the lever-arm prior — **one column cannot decide; the n-trajectory can** (a harmonic tracks k·f_light(n) exactly; a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve, diverging toward 0.9·F_L at low n). Hole side (run 7) is capped at n = −1.27×10¹² by the TG limit — the near-CNP exception regime (close, balanced tone set; strong 12.3 T ≈ F_L tone) — excluded from the fan: it cannot reach the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² separation window at any price; its record stands as consistency input.

**Design (all computed, `landau-fan` step 1 + investigation Step 2):** fast axis n = +3.25 → +1.2×10¹² at D = 0 (81 cols; Vtg +0.411..+0.998 V, Vbg +0.425..+1.185 V — inside validators); slow axis uniform-1/B 0.75 → 10 T ascending, 126 rows, Δ(1/B) = 0.00987 ≤ 1/(3·F_L(n_max) = 33.6 T), Nyquist f_max 50.7 T (captures F_L sum-tone and 4×light unaliased). δF = 0.81 T separates heavy(26.1)/3×light(22.4)/4×light(29.9)/F_L(33.6) at n_max with ≥ 4·δF margins. Partner 5-period floor f ≥ 4.05 T → partition claim window n ≳ 2.2×10¹²; columns below feed the trajectory read (heavy → 0.9·F_L divergence is strongest there). n-axis: 2.8 cols per ray at B_lo = 0.75 T (≥ 2 floor). B_lo: run 6's onset is censored at the 0.30 T record edge (sub-1 T leg is 50 mT — undersampled for the 7 T tone below ~0.85 T), so onset does not bind; B_lo = 0.75 T is the cost/δF floor. B_hi = 10 T buys the ν = 8, 12, 16 layer-number complement (~3 rows, ~18 min marginal). **Sensitivity** 100 µV (10 kΩ FS): worst corner low-n × high-B — run 7 at |n| = 1.2×10¹² read 576 Ω at 10 T rising; 17× headroom (run-4 lesson: size ≥ 10×, saturation is the asymmetric failure). Dwell: fast_delay 1.8 s = 6τ (τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB — per-column FFT reads point values, asserted in-cell).

**Price:** grid 10,206 pts × 1.97 s/pt (run-5 calibration: 1.17 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0 → +0.8 s dwell) = 5.6 h + traverse 9.25 T / 0.137 + 126×3 s settle = 74 min + row overhead 4 min ≈ 6.9 h; realistic ≈ **7.5 h**. Ends: B = 10 T (held — next step rides it down), gates parked at 0.

**Checkpoints** (`hera-watch` armed on this run): first rows (~10 min: leakage < 1 nA, no rail, sr1 signal sane vs run 6); then ~2 h (row ~55, B ≈ 1.2 T — half the 1/B record: light-tone F(n) track forming, clipping scan), ~4 h (row ~95, B ≈ 2.5 T — partial per-column FFT: heavy/harmonic separation emerging), ~6 h (row ~115, B ≈ 5 T). Abort calls: rail/clip anywhere (re-run costs less than a corrupted FFT), leak trip, T_sample off base, or no oscillation content by the 2 h checkpoint where run 6 showed onset.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n +1.2 -> +3.25e12 x B 0.75 -> 10 T (uniform 1/B) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)

# --- fast axis: paired-(Vtg, Vbg) n-line at D = 0, n descending +3.25 -> +1.2 e12 (81 cols) ---
ns = np.linspace(3.25, 1.2, 81)                 # 1e12 cm^-2; claim window n >= ~2.2 (partner 5-period floor)
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f} e12 (81 cols), Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B, 0.75 -> 10 T ascending (magnet sits at 0; fan ends at 10 T for the next step) ---
N_B = 126                                        # d(1/B) = 0.00987 <= 1/(3*F_L(n_max)=33.6 T); Nyq f_max 50.7 T
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1/0.75, 1/10.0, N_B)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
I_TRIP = 1e-9

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not reset to 1"
_tau = sr1.time_constant()
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 0.01, f"sr1 tau changed: {_tau} s (dwell math assumes 0.3 s / 24 dB)"
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 0.01, f"drive amplitude {sr1.amplitude()} V != 1.0 (I_bias sizing assumes 10 nA)"

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA — sized to the global worst corner
# (low n x high B: run 7 analog at |n|=1.2e12 read 576 Ohm at 10 T and rising; QH peaks headroom 17x).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0                # 6*tau dwell (per-column FFT reads point values); gates retrace inside the field ramp
print(f"B rows: {N_B}, {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS), tau {_tau} s; "
      f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY}, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY}")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan-vti: D = 0 electron fan, n = +1.2..+3.25e12 (81 cols), B 0.75 -> 10 T uniform-1/B "
                  "(126 rows, d(1/B)=0.00987), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s (6 tau); cal run 5; spots runs 6/7")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0.00 V/nm, n = {ns[-1]:+.2f} to {ns[0]:+.2f} e12 cm^-2 (81 cols, fast, descending), '
              f'B = {B_vec[0]:.3f} to {B_vec[-1]:.1f} T (126 rows, uniform 1/B, ascending); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'B_lo bound by spot run 6 (light tone censored at 0.30 T record edge)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
# field stays at 10 T (deliberate — next step decides the descent; never re-traverse).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, gates parked at 0, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
